degree_rationale: How the light comes forth through gates and mansions of firmaments — radiating rays going inward through firmament-gates, drawing up the kind/light, casting unworthy kind down. Treats the natural pathway-completion through which light moves.
direction_rationale: The settled/established gate-and-mansion route through which light moves — completion of the natural pathway-system.
grand_man_function: Natural light-conduit completion — the gates through which light operates.
title: How light comes forth through gates and mansions of the firmaments
